description: This file defines data models and enums related to scheduled jobs, including their configuration, execution, and logging within a scheduling system. It includes entities for job schedules, payloads, delivery modes, session targets, and logs, supporting serialization, deserialization, and identification of scheduled tasks.

classes.name: CronJob
classes.description: Represents a scheduled job with configuration details, status, and associated entities.

classes.name: CronSchedule
classes.description: Defines the scheduling pattern for a job, supporting specific times, intervals, and cron expressions.

classes.name: CronPayload
classes.description: Represents the payload or message content to be sent or processed by the scheduled job.

classes.name: CronDelivery
classes.description: Specifies how and where the job notifications or messages are delivered.

classes.name: CronJobState
classes.description: Tracks runtime state information for a scheduled job, such as last run time and status.

classes.name: CronEvent
classes.description: Details a scheduled job event, including execution times and outcomes.

classes.name: CronRunLogEntry
classes.description: Contains logged execution data for a job run, including timestamps, status, and errors.

classes.name: CronListResponse
classes.description: Response structure containing a list of scheduled jobs.

classes.name: CronRunsResponse
classes.description: Response structure containing a list of job run log entries.

methods.name: from
methods.description: Creates a CronCustomSessionTarget from a string value.

methods.name: parseAtDate
methods.description: Parses a string into a Date object based on ISO8601 format.

methods.name: formatIsoDate
methods.description: Formats a Date object into an ISO8601 string.

methods.name: makeIsoFormatter
methods.description: Creates an ISO8601DateFormatter with specified fractional seconds options.
